blocks.text: Har circular ya orbital motion ke liye centripetal force chahiye, jo koi na koi cheez deti hai:

items: Gend ko dori se horizontal daire mein ghumayein to dori ki tension centripetal force deti hai.
Turntable (ghoomti plate) par rakhi cheez ke liye friction (ragar) centripetal force hai.
Gravitational force ki wajah se Zameen Suraj ke gird, aur Chand aur artificial (insaan ka banaya hua) satellites Zameen ke gird ghoomte hain.
Magnetic force jo charged particle ki velocity ke perpendicular ho, use seedhe raste se mod kar daire mein chalati hai.

Sarak par murti gari ko bhi centripetal force chahiye, jo tyres aur sarak ki friction deti hai. Sarak phislan wali ho to tez speed par friction kafi nahi hoti; gari mur nahi pati aur phisal (skid) sakti hai ya ulat sakti hai. Is liye moron par highway ko banked banaya jata hai: track ka outer kinara andar wale kinare se thora ooncha rakha jata hai.

blocks.text: Bohat tez liye jane wale moron par banked tracks chahiye, kyunke wahan sirf friction kafi centripetal force nahi de sakti.
blocks.title: Tid-bits

blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke friction centripetal force ke liye “energy” nahi de sakti. Centripetal force ek force hai, energy nahi; friction (aur banked track) khud yeh force deti hai. Sahi jumla: sirf friction kafi centripetal force nahi de sakti.
